ticket_text: The invoice for our April subscription shows an incorrect amount; we only paid for three months, not four. We believe this is an error in billing and have attached a copy of our payment confirmation. Can you verify and correct this before the end of the month?

I'm trying to request a new feature where the app automatically syncs with Google Calendar to show upcoming meetings in the project board. It would be very helpful for our team to track deadlines. I know there's already a Slack integration, so I'm wondering if this is something you're considering. I've been using the app for a year and it's been great, but this feature would make our workflow much smoother. I also noticed that when I try to export data, the file sometimes has outdated information, which might be related to sync issues. I don't know if that's a bug or just a limitation, but it's making it harder to stay on top of our schedule.

I need a new feature to allow bulk import of client data directly into the project board — it would save hours every week. The current CSV export only works for one client at a time, and we're missing critical information from the sales team. Can you add this functionality soon? We're already using the app heavily and this would be a major time-saver.

We’re seeing a 30% drop in invoice conversion rates after switching to the new billing portal. Can you add a 'pre-invoice review' step where admins can approve or reject invoices before they’re sent out? It would save us hours of manual corrections and reduce errors. This is urgent because the deadline for Q2 reports is tomorrow and we’ve already missed two client confirmations.
I can't export data to Excel anymore, but I'd really like to see a new integration with Asana. The export feature is broken, and I'm worried it might affect billing reports.

I've been using the Northbeam platform for a few months now and I noticed that there's no option to set custom labels on tasks in the project boards. It would be really helpful if we could add labels like 'urgent' or 'follow-up' to better organize our workflow. This could improve task visibility and team coordination, especially in high-priority projects. I don't see any similar functionality in the current interface, and it seems like a small change that could make a big difference for users managing complex workloads.

We urgently need a feature to export data by custom date ranges — right now, we can only export entire months, and we're missing critical client data for Q1. This is blocking our audit process and will delay our financial close by two weeks.

The payment for our March subscription expired and the system now shows the workspace as suspended. We've tried to update the card, but the charge fails every time. We're unsure if this is due to a declined card or a system error in processing. We need to restore access to billing so we can continue using the platform.

I'm really frustrated that the export feature only works for CSV, not Excel — it's been like this for months. I've tried asking before, but nothing changes. Our clients need Excel files to process invoices, and right now we're stuck. It's a huge pain. I mean, really, why can't we just get a proper export option? I don't understand why this hasn't been fixed. It's been a major blocker for our workflow. I know it's not urgent, but it's definitely not working. I'm just asking for a real solution — something that actually works for us. Maybe we could add a new integration with Airtable too, just so we can sync better with our team.

I really need a new feature that allows users to set up automated email notifications for task completions. Right now, we have to manually check and follow up, which takes a lot of time. This would save our team hours every week. I’ve been using the app for over a year and it’s been great overall, but this specific workflow is missing. I’m not sure if it’s already possible, but I’d love to know. Could you please add this to your roadmap? It would be a huge help for project tracking and team coordination.

I'd like to request a new feature that allows users to export project timelines in PDF format directly from the dashboard. This would help our clients with reporting and compliance, especially since they need to share documents with external auditors. The current export options only offer CSV and JSON, which aren't suitable for formal documentation. I've checked the help center and there's no mention of this capability. I'm not sure if this is already available, but I believe it would be a significant improvement for our workflow. It would be great if we could also customize the layout, like adding headers or footers. I've been using the platform for over a year and have not seen this feature, so I think it's something that could be added in the next update.
We need a new dashboard view that shows real-time project status and team workload allocation. It would help us track progress across departments more efficiently.

We're currently using the project timeline feature, but it would be very helpful if the app allowed us to set custom timeblocks for team meetings. This would make it easier to visualize busy periods and reduce scheduling conflicts across departments.

I can't pay the invoice for March — my card is declined, and I've tried three different cards. The payment failed and the system says it's now suspended, even though I'm not using all my seats. I didn't realize the charge was due until today, and I'm worried about being locked out of the workspace. I need to resolve this before the next billing cycle starts, or we'll lose access to the project timelines. Can you check if there's a manual override or a refund for this? I also need to know what the exact charge amount was and if I can dispute it with my bank.

I'm reaching out to request a new feature that would allow users to set up automated reminders for upcoming project deadlines. This would help teams stay on track without manually tracking milestones. The current system doesn’t support this, and I’ve found it’s a common pain point across several teams we support. If possible, could you include this in the next feature roadmap?

We urgently need a new feature to allow manual override of team-wide sync status — right now, every time a sync fails, the entire team loses access to updates, which is killing our workflow. This is causing delays in client deliverables and we’re under pressure to deliver by Friday. Can you please add this as soon as possible?
We need a new export format for our reports — specifically, CSV with timestamped headers and column filters. This is urgent as our clients rely on it for compliance.
I'd love to see a new feature where I can schedule recurring tasks in the project boards — it would save so much time with repetitive work.
We received an invoice for March that includes a $500 charge for 100 additional seats, which was not part of our plan. We did not authorize this change and believe it is incorrect.

We need a way to schedule recurring tasks in the project tracker — like automated reminders for milestones or invoice due dates. Right now, we have to manually create these, which takes up 3 hours every week. We’re worried about missing deadlines and want this feature ASAP to avoid operational delays.
I've been requesting the ability to export reports in PDF format for some time now. It would greatly improve our compliance process with clients.

I would like to request a new feature that allows users to schedule recurring tasks within the project board. Currently, we can only create one-off tasks, which makes it difficult to manage ongoing workflows like weekly team check-ins or monthly client reviews. This would save time and reduce the need to manually recreate tasks repeatedly. I've seen similar functionality in other project management tools and believe it would greatly improve usability for teams managing regular operations.
The payment for our March subscription failed and we're unable to access the dashboard to confirm the status.
I need a feature that allows me to export reports in Excel format — right now I have to manually copy-paste and it takes forever. Can we add this by next month?

We’re currently using the Northbeam platform for project tracking, and we’ve noticed that there’s no option to schedule recurring automated reports. This would save our team time and reduce manual errors. Could you please consider adding a feature to allow users to set up recurring report schedules, such as weekly or monthly deliveries via email?
We need a way to export team-wide activity logs as a CSV — right now we can only export individual user data, which isn’t helpful for audits.

I need a feature to export team-wide activity logs in CSV format so we can track project timelines and audit compliance. The current export only gives individual user data, which isn't helpful for cross-team visibility. Can we add this please? It's been two weeks since we requested it and we're still missing this functionality.

We'd like to see a way to schedule recurring reports automatically, like monthly summaries for our team. It would help with compliance. The current export is manual and takes too long. Also, the dashboard shows data from the wrong month sometimes, which is confusing.

We’ve been using Northbeam for several months and would like to request a new feature that allows us to schedule recurring automation rules. Currently, we can only set up one-time workflows, which makes managing monthly reports and recurring tasks inefficient. This would significantly reduce the manual work we do each month. The feature should support custom recurrence intervals (daily, weekly, monthly) and allow us to define conditions and triggers based on time, such as 'run every Monday at 9 AM' or 'run on the 1st of each month'. We’re not seeing any issues with the current platform, and the request is purely for improved workflow efficiency.

Our team has been trying to request a new dashboard view that shows project milestones and budget tracking together. We've seen this in other tools and it would help with reporting. However, we're also concerned that the billing for this feature might be higher than expected, and we're not sure if it's already included in our plan. We'd like to know if it's available or if there's a cost involved.
